description.text: A starter deck built around Salamence, released on 25 June 2003 alongside Rulers of the Heavens, the ADV expansion full of dragon Pokémon, with a Flygon deck as its partner. Latias ex is among its Pokémon. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
